subject: DSCR is brutal right now
preheader: the one ratio that decides whether your loan exists.
headline: DSCR is the lender's secret formula. Model it before you write the offer.
body: Debt Service Coverage Ratio = NOI / Annual Debt Service. A property generating $24,000 NOI with $20,000 in annual mortgage payments has a DSCR of 1.20.

Lenders care about DSCR more than they care about your tax return. Most non-QM DSCR loans in 2026 want 1.20-1.25 minimum. Some want 1.30. A few aggressive lenders will go to 1.15 with a rate bump and a bigger down payment.

Here's the trap: at today's rates (6.5-7.5% for investor loans), a lot of cap-rate-decent properties don't clear DSCR. A 7% cap rate property with 75% LTV at 7% interest often comes in at DSCR 1.08-1.15. Lender says no. You're stuck putting more cash down or walking.

Model DSCR before relying on a financing scenario. A modeled 1.18 and 1.32 indicate different screening cushions, but neither determines lender eligibility or tells you whether or how to offer. Confirm the lender's written DSCR definition, rent basis, leverage, reserves, and other program rules.
